title: Bạn có thể viết ra chính sách hủy được không?
englishTitle: Can you write down the cancellation policy?
pronunciation: Ban co the viet ra chinh sach huy duoc khong
summary: For getting cancellation rules in writing before you pay, extend, or leave a deposit.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: The rule matters most when a room, tour, deposit, or date change is still undecided.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Show the booking screen and ask for the written rule. A photo, message, or receipt is easier to compare later.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể viết ra chính sách hủy được không?
phrases.english: Can you write down the cancellation policy?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the viet ra chinh sach huy duoc khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Bạn có thể asks can you; viết ra means write down; chính sách hủy means cancellation policy; được không makes it polite.

breakdown.vietnamese: Bạn có thể viết ra chính sách hủy được không?
breakdown.english: Can you write down the cancellation policy?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Reservation and check-in phrases cover the opening move before policy details.

phrases.english: I’d like to check in, please

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotel desks, tour counters, homestays, and booking chats before paying or changing dates.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Ask for the amount, deadline, and refund method in the same written note if money is involved.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: After the rule is written down, the next questions are usually canceling the stay, checking the deposit, or confirming where any refund goes.
